package main
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "strings"
 detector "retrom/internal/capability/engine/tyranoscript/detector"
)
type index []detector.File
func (v index) Files() []detector.File { return append([]detector.File(nil), v...) }
type observation struct {
 Name string `json:"name"`
 Files []detector.File `json:"files"`
 Profile detector.Profile `json:"profile"`
 Error string `json:"error"`
 ErrorType string `json:"errorType"`
 Invalid bool `json:"invalid"`
 Snapshot string `json:"snapshot"`
}
func main() {
 valid:=[]detector.File{{Path:"index.html",Size:1},{Path:"data/scenario/first.ks",Size:1},{Path:"data/system/Config.tjs",Size:1},{Path:"tyrano/plugins/kag/kag.js",Size:1},{Path:"tyrano/tyrano.js",Size:1}}
 cases:=[]observation{{Name:"nil"},{Name:"empty",Files:[]detector.File{}},{Name:"complete",Files:valid}}
 add:=func(name string, files []detector.File){cases=append(cases,observation{Name:name,Files:files})}
 for i:=range valid { f:=append([]detector.File{},valid[:i]...);f=append(f,valid[i+1:]...);add(fmt.Sprintf("missing-%d",i),f) }
 upper:=append([]detector.File{},valid...);for i:=range upper {upper[i].Path=strings.ToUpper(upper[i].Path)};add("uppercase",upper)
 reversed:=append([]detector.File{},valid...);for i:=0;i<len(reversed)/2;i++ {j:=len(reversed)-i-1;reversed[i],reversed[j]=reversed[j],reversed[i]};add("reversed",reversed)
 for _,path:=range []string{"", ".", "../outside","/absolute","a//b", "a\\b","a\x00b",strings.Repeat("a",1024),strings.Repeat("a",1025),"资源/追加.ks"} {f:=append([]detector.File{},valid...);f=append(f,detector.File{Path:path,Size:0});add(fmt.Sprintf("extra-%d",len(cases)),f)}
 for _,size:=range []int64{-1,0,9223372036854775807} {f:=append([]detector.File{},valid...);f[0].Size=size;add(fmt.Sprintf("size-%d",size),f)}
 add("case-duplicate",append(append([]detector.File{},valid...),detector.File{Path:"INDEX.HTML",Size:1}))
 for i:=range cases {
  profile,err:=detector.Detect(index(cases[i].Files));cases[i].Profile=profile;cases[i].Invalid=errors.Is(err,detector.ErrProjectInvalid)
  if err!=nil {cases[i].Error=err.Error();cases[i].ErrorType=fmt.Sprintf("%T",err)} else {data,err:=detector.MarshalSnapshot(profile);if err!=nil {panic(err)};cases[i].Snapshot=string(data)}
 }
 e:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout);e.SetIndent("","  ");if err:=e.Encode(cases);err!=nil {panic(err)}
}
